name: Girando
tagline: Turning, warm, a piazza at golden hour
lineage: New — not yet defined anywhere but here.
story: DRAFT — a sketch to rewrite in your own words. The guess, from the name (girando: turning): a warm place in motion. A carousel slowing down in a southern square, terracotta and ochre catching the last hour of sun, shutters half closed, everything a little circular — things arrive by turning in rather than sliding.
principles: Warmth first: every colour is lit by a low sun.
Motion curves — things rotate or arc into place, nothing tracks straight.
Round is the default shape; a circle is at home here.
Generous, unhurried spacing: a square, not a corridor.
do: Let entrances turn: small rotations, arcs, a settling spin.
Pair terracotta with a cooling note (the shutter teal) so it never overheats.
dont: No pure grey — everything warms toward sand.
No abrupt cuts; this place never jump-cuts.

body.stack: 'Gill Sans', 'Gill Sans MT', Seravek, 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif

motion.character: Everything turns in — small rotations on entry, long easings, a carousel slowing rather than a machine stopping.

texture.notes: Faint stucco grain; sunlight rather than pattern.

notes: DRAFT seeded as a starting point — every value here is a guess for the editor to correct, especially the story.
